dataset: PIXray official split only; PIDray not included

protocol.dataset: official PIXray split: 3,560 train / 1,486 test images
protocol.optimizer: AdamW lr=1e-4 weight_decay=0.05, betas/eps torch defaults (0.9, 0.999) / 1e-8, one parameter group; learning rate kept from the batch-16 protocol, not rescaled for the effective batch of 4
protocol.warmup: LinearLR start_factor=0.001, iteration-based, 25 iterations x 4 = 100 images (historical: 50 iterations x 2 = 100 images)
protocol.cosine: CosineAnnealingLR epoch-based, begin=1 end=50 T_max=50 eta_min=1e-7 (historical end=60 T_max=60; shortened with the schedule at the user's instruction, same shape)
protocol.train_loader: DefaultSampler shuffle=True, no batch sampler, num_workers=2, persistent workers
protocol.cuda_launch_blocking: 0 for every campaign run (historical tools/train.py forced 1; no effect on computation)
